theorems.label: cycle-packing-degree-six
theorems.statement: Assuming deterministic FPT ≠ W[1], for each fixed 0<γ<1 there is no deterministic effective 2^(o(t log₂ t)) N^(O(1)) Cycle Packing algorithm by treewidth or by supplied path-decomposition width, even on connected bipartite graphs of maximum degree six, girth at least n^(1−γ), and equal treewidth and pathwidth, with an optimal certificate if supplied.

title: Cycle Packing at bounded degree and large girth
